package mock_mcp_test

// Golden generator for github.com/xdxer/dws-for-tag/dws/clicompat. It runs the real
// dws v1.0.62-beta.8 production entrypoint (TestCLIHelperProcess re-exec)
// against a fake MCP gateway and records the tool calls dws made plus its
// stdout, stderr and exit code. Run with DWSCLI_GOLDEN_OUT=<file>.
//
// To regenerate dws/clicompat/testdata/dws_goldens.json: check out
// github.com/DingTalk-Real-AI/dingtalk-workspace-cli at tag v1.0.62-beta.8,
// copy this file to test/mock_mcp/clicompat_golden_test.go (it reuses that
// package's isolatedCLIEnv, runCLI and TestCLIHelperProcess), and run
//
//	DWSCLI_GOLDEN_OUT=$PWD/dws_goldens.json go test ./test/mock_mcp/ -run TestDWSCLIGolden -count=1
//
// with CGO enabled (the default on macOS/Linux) so the SafeChat backend is
// compiled in as in release builds.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type goldenResponse struct {
	Kind       string `json:"kind"` // text | isError | http | rpc | structured
	Text       string `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Status     int    `json:"status,omitempty"`
	RPCCode    int    `json:"rpcCode,omitempty"`
	RPCMessage string `json:"rpcMessage,omitempty"`
}

type goldenRequest struct {
	Path      string          `json:"path"`
	Tool      string          `json:"tool"`
	Arguments json.RawMessage `json:"arguments"`
}

type goldenCase struct {
	Name      string                    `json:"name"`
	Args      []string                  `json:"args"`
	Responses map[string]goldenResponse `json:"responses"`
	Requests  []goldenRequest           `json:"requests"`
	Stdout    string                    `json:"stdout"`
	Stderr    string                    `json:"stderr"`
	Exit      int                       `json:"exit"`
}

func text(s string) goldenResponse { return goldenResponse{Kind: "text", Text: s} }

// goldenTempDir matches the per-run isolated config directory dws mentions in
// SafeChat login-state errors.
var goldenTempDir = regexp.MustCompile(`/[^"\s]*/TestDWSCLIGolden[0-9]+/`)

const (
	gCID    = "cidTEST000000001"
	gMID    = "msgTEST0001"
	gDID    = "DAAAAAAAAAAAiE"
	gDID2   = "DAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAiEiE"
	gCipher = "SwzNkAraDE6lUHUNlVT3mjFdbxL6dWvmt77XtjACdpJx9VFibzTbW9KtDbkzGOYP||2||1||1"
)

func listArgs() []string {
	return []string{"chat", "message", "list", "--group", gCID, "--time", "2026-09-30 11:59:59.123", "--direction", "older", "--limit", "21", "--format", "json"}
}

func sendArgs(extra ...string) []string {
	return append([]string{"chat", "message", "send"}, extra...)
}

func replyArgs(content, key, aiTag, group, mid string) []string {
	return []string{"chat", "+messages-reply", "--content", content, "--idempotency-key", key, "--ai-tag=" + aiTag, "--format", "json", "--yes", "--group", group, "--message-id", mid}
}

	lookupOK := text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","openConversationId":"` + gCID + `","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `","content":"原消息"}]}}`)

		goldenCase{Name: "reply/ok-aitag", Args: replyArgs("收到 <b>&", "RK1", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"openTaskId":"RT1"}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/ok-no-aitag", Args: replyArgs("  收到  ", " RK2 ", "false", " "+gCID+" ", " "+gMID+" "), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`{"result":{"openTaskId":"RT2","openMessageId":"om-2","sendStatus":"SUCCESS","n":1.50}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/nested-sender", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK3", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":[{"messageId":"` + gMID + `","conversationId":"` + gCID + `","sender":{"openDingTalkId":"` + gDID2 + `"}}]}`), sendTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"openTaskId":"RT3"}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/alliance", Args: replyArgs("@alliance hi", "RK4", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"openTaskId":"RT4"}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/undeclared-mention", Args: replyArgs("hi @"+gDID, "RK5", "true", gCID, gMID)},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/at-all", Args: replyArgs("hi @all", "RK6", "true", gCID, gMID)},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/blank-body", Args: replyArgs("   ", "RK7", "true", gCID, gMID)},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/conversation-mismatch", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK8", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","openConversationId":"cidOTHER00000001","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `"}]}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/no-sender", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK9", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","openConversationId":"` + gCID + `","sender":"张三"}]}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/duplicate-source", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK10", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","openConversationId":"` + gCID + `","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `"},{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","openConversationId":"` + gCID + `","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `"}]}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/not-found", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK11", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"other","openConversationId":"` + gCID + `","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `"}]}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/missing-conversation", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK12", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"messages":[{"openMessageId":"` + gMID + `","senderOpenDingTalkId":"` + gDID + `"}]}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/send-duplicate", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK13", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`{"success":false,"errorCode":"1001","errorMsg":"sendPersonalMessageSyncByServerPush error: Request is repeated with uuid 'RK13'.","traceId":"trace-rdup"}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/lookup-business", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK14", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`{"success":false,"errorCode":"130003","errorMsg":"OpenId is not in conversation"}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/send-empty-object", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK15", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`{}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/zero-width", Args: replyArgs("a​b", "RK16", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/lookup-plain-text", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK17", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`plain`)}},
	)

	a2uiTool := "create_and_send_a2ui_card"
	a2uiMsgs := `["{\"version\":\"v1.0\",\"surfaceUpdate\":{\"surfaceId\":\"s\"}}","{\"b\":\"<x>&\"}"]`
	a2uiArgs := func(target, id string) []string {
		return []string{"chat", "+messages-send", "--as", "user", target, id, "--msg-type", "a2ui", "--a2ui-messages", a2uiMsgs, "--biz-card-id", "B1", "--request-id", "R1", "--card-summary", "摘要 <s>", "--yes", "--format", "json"}
	}
	cases = append(cases,
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/group", Args: a2uiArgs("--chat-id", gCID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"bizId":"B1","cardInstanceId":42,"note":"<a&b>"}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/direct-big", Args: a2uiArgs("--open-dingtalk-id", gDID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`{"result":{"bizId":"B1","cardInstanceId":12345678901234567891}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/rejected", Args: a2uiArgs("--chat-id", gCID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`{"success":false,"errorCode":"A2UI_TARGET_INVALID","errorMsg":"A2UI card target group does not belong to the creator organization","traceId":"trace123"}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/bad-open-id", Args: a2uiArgs("--open-dingtalk-id", "user-1")},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/trimmed", Args: []string{"chat", "+messages-send", "--as", "user", "--chat-id", " " + gCID + " ", "--msg-type", "a2ui", "--a2ui-messages", " " + a2uiMsgs + " ", "--biz-card-id", " B2 ", "--request-id", " R2 ", "--card-summary", " s ", "--yes", "--format", "json"}, Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"bizId":"B2","cardInstanceId":7}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/empty-messages", Args: []string{"chat", "+messages-send", "--as", "user", "--chat-id", gCID, "--msg-type", "a2ui", "--a2ui-messages", `[]`, "--biz-card-id", "B3", "--request-id", "R3", "--card-summary", "s", "--yes", "--format", "json"}},
	)

	updTool := "update_a2ui_card"
	updArgs := func(biz, status, annotations string) []string {
		args := []string{"chat", "message", "update-a2ui-card", "--biz-id", biz, "--content", `["{\"updateDataModel\":{\"surfaceId\":\"s\"}}"]`, "--flow-status", status}
		if annotations != "-" {
			args = append(args, "--a2ui-annotations", annotations)
		}
		return append(args, "--format", "json")
	}
	cases = append(cases,
		goldenCase{Name: "update/confirming", Args: updArgs("B1", "confirming", `[{"surfaceId":"s","componentId":"question","type":"artifact"}]`), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{updTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"updated":true,"n":1.50,"html":"<p>"}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/numeric-status", Args: updArgs(" B1 ", " 8 ", `[]`), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{updTool: text(`{"result":true}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/no-annotations", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", "-"), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{updTool: text(`{"success":true}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/bad-status", Args: updArgs("B1", "DONE", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/space-biz", Args: updArgs("B 1", "FINISH", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/placeholder-biz", Args: updArgs("<bizId>", "FINISH", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/null-annotations", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", `null`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/business", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", `[]`), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{updTool: text(`{"success":false,"errorCode":"CARD_NOT_FOUND","errorMsg":"card not found"}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/plain-text", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", `[]`), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{updTool: text(`ok`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/empty-biz", Args: updArgs("", "FINISH", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/blank-biz", Args: updArgs("   ", "FINISH", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/zero-width-biz", Args: updArgs("B​1", "FINISH", `[]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/non-object-annotation", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", `[null]`)},
		goldenCase{Name: "update/scalar-annotations", Args: updArgs("B1", "FINISH", `[1]`)},
	)

	// Null payloads (plain-text tool answers) and remaining edges.
	cases = append(cases,
		goldenCase{Name: "crossorg/plain-text", Args: crossArgs, Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{grant: text(`granted`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "status/plain-text", Args: statusArgs, Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{statusTool: text(`done`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "byids/plain-text", Args: byIDsArgs, Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: text(`none`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/plain-text", Args: a2uiArgs("--chat-id", gCID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`sent`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/send-plain-text", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK18", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: lookupOK, sendTool: text(`sent`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "reply/lookup-is-error", Args: replyArgs("ok", "RK19", "true", gCID, gMID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{byIDs: {Kind: "isError", Text: `lookup failed`}}},
		goldenCase{Name: "send/big-number", Args: sendArgs("--content", "x", "--idempotency-key", "K22", "--ai-tag=true", "--format", "json", "--conversation-id", gCID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{sendTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"openTaskId":"T22","n":12345678901234567891,"f":1.50}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "send/title-and-mention", Args: sendArgs("--content", "@"+gDID+" 看 https://x.test", "--idempotency-key", "K23", "--ai-tag=true", "--format", "json", "--title", "  标题  ", "--conversation-id", gCID, "--at-open-dingtalk-ids", gDID), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{sendTool: pending}},
		goldenCase{Name: "list/is-error-empty", Args: listArgs(), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{listTool: {Kind: "isError", Text: ``}}},
		goldenCase{Name: "list/http-404", Args: listArgs(), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{listTool: {Kind: "http", Status: 404, Text: `not found`}}},
		goldenCase{Name: "list/conversation-groups", Args: listArgs(), Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{listTool: text(`{"result":{"conversationMessagesList":[{"openConversationId":"cid-g","title":"群","messages":[{"openMessageId":"g1","content":"hi"}]}],"hasMore":false}}`)}},
		goldenCase{Name: "a2ui/default-ids", Args: []string{"chat", "+messages-send", "--as", "user", "--chat-id", gCID, "--msg-type", "a2ui", "--a2ui-messages", `["a","b"]`, "--yes", "--format", "json"}, Responses: map[string]goldenResponse{a2uiTool: text(`{"success":true,"result":{"bizId":"auto","cardInstanceId":1}}`)}},
	)
	return cases
}

func TestDWSCLIGolden(t *testing.T) {
	out := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DWSCLI_GOLDEN_OUT"))
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("DWSCLI_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	cases := goldenCases()
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		var mu sync.Mutex
		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			var envelope struct {
				ID     int `json:"id"`
				Params struct {
					Name      string          `json:"name"`
					Arguments json.RawMessage `json:"arguments"`
				} `json:"params"`
			}
			if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&envelope); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "bad request", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			mu.Lock()
			c.Requests = append(c.Requests, goldenRequest{Path: r.URL.Path, Tool: envelope.Params.Name, Arguments: envelope.Params.Arguments})
			mu.Unlock()
			spec, ok := c.Responses[envelope.Params.Name]
			if !ok {
				spec = goldenResponse{Kind: "rpc", RPCCode: -32601, RPCMessage: "unexpected tool " + envelope.Params.Name}
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			switch spec.Kind {
			case "http":
				w.WriteHeader(spec.Status)
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(spec.Text))
			case "rpc":
				_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": envelope.ID, "error": map[string]any{"code": spec.RPCCode, "message": spec.RPCMessage}})
			default:
				result := map[string]any{"content": []map[string]any{{"type": "text", "text": spec.Text}}}
				if spec.Kind == "isError" {
					result["isError"] = true
				}
				_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": envelope.ID, "result": result})
			}
		}))
		env := isolatedCLIEnv(t, map[string]string{
			"DINGTALK_CHAT_MCP_URL": server.URL + "/server/chat",
			"DINGTALK_IM_MCP_URL":   server.URL + "/server/im",
			"DWS_LANG":              "en",
		})
		args := append([]string{"--token", "ci-smoke-token"}, c.Args...)
		stdout, stderr, err := runCLI(t, env, args...)
		server.Close()
		c.Stdout = goldenTempDir.ReplaceAllString(strings.ReplaceAll(stdout, server.URL, "{{GATEWAY}}"), "{{TMPDIR}}/")
		c.Stderr = goldenTempDir.ReplaceAllString(strings.ReplaceAll(stderr, server.URL, "{{GATEWAY}}"), "{{TMPDIR}}/")
		var exitErr *exec.ExitError
		if errors.As(err, &exitErr) {
			c.Exit = exitErr.ExitCode()
		} else if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", c.Name, err)
		}
		if c.Requests == nil {
			c.Requests = []goldenRequest{}
		}
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
